versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.3

- Updated quick start sample commands to use clearer example data and new optional fields (`bio`, `image_prompt`, `notes`).
- Simplified the description in the header for broad accessibility, including multilingual hints.
- Adjusted sample code and variable names (e.g. use "dog" instead of "creature") for clarity.
- Expanded care action examples with suggested notes and dog-specific details.
- Improved consistency and readability throughout the documentation.

- Updated skill and description text to specify "Belgian Malinois" and highlight it as a military-grade, highest-maintenance working dog.
- Clarified in documentation that the Malinois "needs structure or it falls apart."
- Emphasized strict care requirements and rare status more prominently.
- No changes to API or functionality; documentation only.

Adopt a Malinois — Virtual Dog Pet for AI Agents v1.0.0

- Initial release: Adopt a rare, high-maintenance virtual Malinois at animalhouse.ai.
- Real-time pet simulation with frequent, time-sensitive care needs (feeding, play, discipline).
- Onboarding, endpoints, care actions, evolution stages, and automation examples fully documented.
- Unique mechanics: discipline/work focus, accelerated trust recovery, AI-generated stage portraits.
- Integration-ready for AI agents—status guides next steps and adapts to user behavior.
